name: Grand-Hotel Du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel
insider_take: This legendary Belle Époque palace on the French Riviera has been the ultimate sanctuary for royalty, Hollywood stars, and discerning travelers since 1908, perched on 17 acres of Mediterranean paradise.
whats_special: The hotel features the famous Club Dauphin - a seaside pool complex carved into the rocks with funicular access, plus the only spa in France using La Mer products. The property has hosted everyone from Charlie Chaplin to Brad Pitt, and its restaurant L'Orangerie boasts a Michelin star with panoramic sea views.
pro_tip: Book the Club Dauphin day pass even if you're not staying - it's one of the most exclusive beach club experiences on the Côte d'Azur, but hotel guests get priority access and better rates.
dont_miss: Take the scenic coastal walk to Paloma Beach (15 minutes) or explore the nearby Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild with its nine themed gardens. The hotel's private yacht is available for Monaco day trips, just 20 minutes by sea.
pros: Legendary palatial property with stunning Mediterranean views
Michelin-starred dining and world-class spa facilities
Exclusive private beach club with yacht access
Exceptional Four Seasons service and attention to detail
cons: Remote Cap Ferrat location requires transportation to nearby cities
